venues.name: Lincoln Park Zoo
venues.why: Free admission and wide, paved loops — parents repeatedly note clean restrooms and easy stroller access.

hl.stroller: Families call out the wide paved loops and ramps — easy going even with a double stroller.
hl.free: Visitors love that walking in is free, so a short, low-key stop never feels wasted.

venues.name: Lou Malnati's Pizzeria
venues.why: Kids’ menu and high chairs on hand. Reserve the noon slot — reviewers mention a wait at peak.

hl.kidmenu: Parents mention high chairs are ready and the kids’ menu keeps little ones happy while the pie bakes.
hl.indoor: A warm indoor booth makes a good midday reset out of the weather.

venues.name: Navy Pier
venues.why: Smooth, flat boardwalk along the lake — the perfect stroller-nap window while you take in the views.

hl.stroller: Reviewers say the flat boardwalk is smooth and stroller-easy from end to end.
hl.naptimed: The long, calm lakefront stretch is where families say the stroller lulls kids right to sleep.

venues.name: Millennium Park
venues.why: Open and calmer by early evening; flat paths around Cloud Gate make for an easy stroller wind-down.

hl.stroller: Level, open paths around Cloud Gate make for simple stroller loops, families note.
hl.free: Free and open late — an easy, no-ticket sunset stop with the kids.

venues.name: Shedd Aquarium
venues.why: All-indoor and stroller-friendly with changing tables — book the early entry to beat the midday crowd.

hl.stroller: Ramps and elevators throughout; visitors confirm it’s fully stroller-friendly.
hl.indoor: Being entirely indoors, families call it the perfect rainy-day plan.

venues.name: Maggie Daley Park
venues.why: Enclosed play areas with one or two entrances make it easy to keep eyes on both kids after nap.

hl.naptimed: Shaded benches near the play garden make an easy pause for a stroller nap.
hl.free: A free play garden families say they come back to again and again.

venues.name: Field Museum
venues.why: SUE the T. rex and a dedicated kids’ Crown Family PlayLab — fully indoor with elevators and changing tables.

hl.stroller: Wide galleries and elevators throughout make it an easy push, parents report.
hl.indoor: A go-to rainy-day pick — hours of indoor space when the weather turns.

venues.name: Museum of Science & Industry
venues.why: Hands-on exhibits built for curious kids; vast and indoor, with a baby-care room families appreciate.

hl.stroller: Big open halls and ramps — reviewers say strollers go everywhere.
hl.indoor: Enormous indoor footprint; an easy full-morning escape from heat or rain.

venues.name: Lincoln Park Conservatory
venues.why: A free, warm indoor garden — a calm, stroller-smooth loop that doubles as a rainy-day backup next to the zoo.

hl.stroller: Flat, paved paths under glass — calm and fully stroller-friendly.
hl.indoor: Warm and green year-round; a quiet indoor option when little ones need to slow down.
hl.free: Free to walk in, so it’s an easy add-on right by Lincoln Park Zoo.

venues.name: Art Institute of Chicago
venues.why: World-class galleries with printable family hunts; strollers welcome and it’s steps from Millennium Park.

hl.stroller: Coat-check a bag, keep the stroller — elevators reach every level.
hl.indoor: A polished indoor option in the heart of the Loop for an art-loving afternoon.

venues.name: Chicago Children's Museum
venues.why: Purpose-built for little kids — water play, a climbing schooner, and a toddler-only zone right on Navy Pier.

hl.stroller: Stroller parking inside and step-free play zones throughout.
hl.indoor: All-indoor and designed for under-5s — a reliable weather backup.

venues.name: North Avenue Beach
venues.why: Soft sand, gentle shallows, and restrooms on site — an easy splashy stop on a warm afternoon.

hl.free: Free lakefront sand and water — budget-friendly fun for a couple of hours.

venues.name: Chicago Riverwalk
venues.why: A flat, car-free path along the river — a smooth stroller stretch with snack stops and skyline views.

hl.stroller: Step-free and wide the whole way — reviewers call it a dream stroller walk.
hl.naptimed: The steady, calm riverside push is a reliable nap-window stroll.
hl.free: No ticket needed — an easy, scenic add-on between Loop stops.

venues.name: Portillo's Hot Dogs
venues.why: Fast, cheap, and beloved by kids — order at the counter, grab a booth, and you’re back on the route quickly.

hl.kidmenu: Sliders, mac & cheese, and high chairs — an easy win with picky eaters.
hl.indoor: Roomy indoor booths make a low-stress midday refuel.

venues.name: Eataly Chicago
venues.why: Casual counters with simple pasta and pizza, high chairs, and room for a stroller beside the table.

hl.kidmenu: Plain pasta and pizza please little eaters; high chairs are on hand.
hl.indoor: A bright indoor food hall near Mag Mile — easy to pop in mid-afternoon.

venues.name: Garfield Park Conservatory
venues.why: One of the country’s largest conservatories with a hands-on Children’s Garden — free, indoor, and calm.

hl.stroller: Smooth indoor paths and a ramped Children’s Garden built for little explorers.
hl.indoor: Lush and warm under glass — a serene rainy-day pick.
hl.free: Admission is free, making it an easy low-key morning.

hotels.name: Loews Chicago Hotel
hotels.why: The highest-rated of the bunch, with a dedicated “Loews Loves Kids” program, a pool, and a short walk to Navy Pier and the Riverwalk — day one of your itinerary is right outside.

hotels.name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Downtown Mag Mile
hotels.why: Apartment-style two-room suites give everyone space to recharge, plus a made-to-order breakfast and a heated pool. Walkable to the Bean and Maggie Daley.
hotels.note: Heads up: ~$65/day parking + a daily resort fee.

hotels.name: Sheraton Grand Chicago Riverwalk
hotels.area: On the Riverwalk · 301 E North Water
hotels.why: Right on the Riverwalk with a pool terrace and easy strolls to the Bean — a comfortable, well-located home base for first-time visitors.

hotels.name: Hyatt Regency Chicago
hotels.why: Big, recently renovated rooms by the river that families say they return to trip after trip. Plenty of on-site dining for nights you don’t want to wander far.
